failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: E2E pipeline test failures cascade from missing plan.md artifact (Plan stage), which breaks Review, Full E2E, Resume, and Cleanup tests downstream; separately an intelligence test fails on unquoted jq numeric parse error
failures.fix: Fix pipeline_stage_plan to write .claude/pipeline-artifacts/plan.md before marking stage complete, and quote/validate the numeric value passed to jq in the complexity-skip check

failures.pattern: [38;2;0;212;255m▸[0m Cleanup: Failure handler removes watch label... [38;2;74;222;128m✓[0m
failures.root_cause: Stale pipeline lock from a prior run left status 'running', causing sw-e2e-integration-test's fast-pipeline test to abort with 'pipeline already in progress'; sw-intent-analysis-test and sw-loop-test fail on unrelated pre-existing assertions (missing schema fields, loop stuckness detection)
failures.fix: Clear/reset the stale pipeline lock before test runs (or add lock cleanup to test setup/teardown) and separately fix intent-analysis schema output and loop stuckness detection logic

failures.root_cause: Pipeline test fixtures assert on plan.md/review.md paths and jq-parsed RL episode fields that no longer match the current sw-pipeline.sh output format, likely due to a prior artifact-path or JSON-output change not reflected in the test mocks
failures.fix: Update sw-pipeline-test.sh assertions and mock outputs to match current artifact paths (.claude/pipeline-artifacts/plan.md, review.md) and ensure RL episode JSON is valid before piping to jq

failures.root_cause: Cross-repo memory promotion test asserts a pattern copy that the promotion function is not performing (logic/assertion mismatch in sw-self-optimize memory promotion path)
failures.fix: Inspect scripts/sw-self-optimize.sh memory promotion function and its test to align expected copy behavior (file path, source/target repo hash, or confidence threshold gating the copy)

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test hit a stale pipeline lock from a prior interrupted run, and sw-intent-analysis-test/sw-recruit-test/sw-daemon-test have schema/auth-check regressions unrelated to that lock
failures.fix: clear stale pipeline lock before e2e run (or auto-abort on lock conflict) and add the missing daemon_preflight_auth_check plus required intent-analysis schema fields (version, goal, criteria)

failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m✓[0m missing schema file yields no payload
failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test and sw-loop-test failed (exit 1), likely due to a missing/absent schema fixture causing the intent-analysis JSON payload generation to short-circuit with no output
failures.fix: Ensure the expected schema fixture file is present/generated before test setup, and add an explicit assertion/error message when the schema file is missing instead of silently yielding an empty payload
